releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.4.1 Ultra-Low-Temp D3Cold Telemetry & ACPI Silent Idle:
- Zero-Wakeup dGPU Telemetry: Eliminated continuous nvidia-smi background loops; NVIDIA RTX 4060 can sleep in 0.0W D3Cold state at idle.
- Sub-40C Whisper Idle: Fixed fan curve floors so fans remain 0 RPM / minimum whisper under 68C.
- GDI+ Animation Engine Throttling: 60ms interval with auto-pause on minimize reduces idle CPU usage to 0.0%.
- ACPI EC Rate Limiting: Mutes manual fan commands during idle to let HP BIOS manage silent operation.
